verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of a business banking and expense platform, so the axis applies. The only AI-related item is a marketing line about receiving AI-generated alerts and strategic insights on spend (conta-simples-docs-21). That is passive analytics, an adjacent feature, not an assistant users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt index and Markdown docs are developer tooling for external agents and earn no credit here.
